outcome: husbands' knowledge of neonatal danger signs
cohort: The study included 613 husbands of postpartum women, who were fathers of infants born within the preceding 6 months, systematically selected from Dessie City, Northeast Ethiopia.
finding: Nearly half of the participating husbands (47%) lacked adequate knowledge of neonatal danger signs, with urban residence, higher educational attainment, having 2-4 children, and receiving information from health professionals significantly associated with greater knowledge.
